title: Burn L5-1
source: Port-authored setup from Tools/puzzles/generate_puzzles.py template 'burn', level 5, variant 1. The line uses engine-supported cards but is not a GBA fixed-board reconstruction.
notes: Burn with Sparks / Spiritual Fire Art - Kurenai, then attack for the remaining LP.

canon_reference.setup_status: canon setup unavailable; this file uses a port-authored template
solution_steps: Use Reinforcement of the Army to get Gearfried the Iron Knight from your deck.
Activate The Warrior Returning Alive to get Marauding Captain from your graveyard to your hand.
With Toon Table of Contents, first get the other two Toon tables from your deck, then Toon World.
Summon Marauding Captain and use him to get out Gearfried.
Use Upstart Goblin to draw the last card from your deck (Upstart Goblin).
With this done, equip Sword of Deep-Seated to Gearfried. It will be destroyed and return to the top of your deck.
Now activate the second Upstart Goblin to draw Sword of Deep-Seated again.
This time, equip it to any other monster (not Gearfried).
Use Blast Magicians effect to destroy both your opponents monsters, and attack directly.
